title: 丹格特集团启动非洲最大规模上市 炼油资产引关注
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Thank you, everyone. Aliko, thank you so good to speak to you.
segments.zh: 谢谢大家。Aliko，很高兴和你交流。

segments.en: What a week you've had. So Africa's biggest IPO opened on Monday.
segments.zh: 这一周你太忙了。非洲最大IPO周一开盘。

segments.en: Frankly, it's just your biggest boldest bet yet, 19 billion Nigerian refinery that you've been building for a decade.
segments.zh: 坦率说，这是你最大胆的押注，190亿尼日利亚炼油厂，建了十年。

segments.en: You're also courting ordinary Africans. You've called the IPO, the People's IPO.
segments.zh: 你也在吸引普通非洲人。你称IPO为“人民的IPO”。

segments.en: And you also have a wide-ranging platforms, including fintechs, mobile phone operators, banks that are being tested because of your listing.
segments.zh: 你还有广泛平台，包括金融科技、移动运营商、银行，因你的上市而受考验。

segments.en: It's been going very, very well. Really, we launched the IPO on Monday.
segments.zh: 非常顺利。我们周一启动了IPO。

segments.en: So immediately after we raised the, I mean, we started, I think, the whole systems crash, including the banks.
segments.zh: 启动后，整个系统承压，包括银行。

segments.en: Only the stock exchange was actually, you know, running our life, you know, but then we did it again.
segments.zh: 只有交易所在运行，但后来我们又做了。

segments.en: I think three days later, it crashed again because of the number of traffic going in there to, you know, parts of it.
segments.zh: 三天后，因流量太大，又承压了。

segments.en: But I'm sure right now they have stabilized. So going forward, you have now a lot of other Africans
segments.zh: 但我确信现在他们已经稳定了。所以接下来，有很多其他非洲人

segments.en: because we have actually now gotten away for them to now invest, you know, from Kenya, from Botswana, from South Africa,
segments.zh: 因为我们现在已经让他们能够**了，你知道，从肯尼亚、博茨瓦纳、南非，

segments.en: we're doing that with a few banks to see that they can go in there and have, you know, the same.
segments.zh: 我们正与几家银行合作，确保他们能进入那里，你知道，同样地。
